environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with direct WebSocket passthrough. Split.io SDK configured with 'localhost' mode using a split.yaml file where all feature flags default to 'off' treatment EXCEPT 'ws-impersonation-debug' which is set to 'on' for all users during an active QA sprint. No authentication middleware on the WebSocket gateway. CORS origin set to wildcard.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB with TCP passthrough on port 443
config.network: public subnet, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443
